title: Fecto Cement source corpus restored
points: FECTC filing-page rows were published into financial_documents_new and filings_fts_new, closing the gap where Fecto Cement numeric answers could appear without source previews.
FECTC reviewed page PDFs and thumbnails were uploaded to the remote source host so source links resolve under source.psxgpt.com.
Pipeline operations now include a scoped document/source publish step for new tickers, with checks for document rows, FTS rows, and source-host assets.
